nodes.label: AGENTS.md Rule Mirror
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md's content under the filename every non-Claude agent reads. Generated by `cargo xtask export-agents-md` rather than symlinked, so a Windows checkout without symlink support gets the rules instead of a 9-byte text file; CI fails when the two disagree.

nodes.label: Project Skills Materialized To .agents/skills
nodes.rationale: Skills live in their own repository so a single copy stays current everywhere; `cargo xtask setup` clones them with plain git so an agent with no vendor CLI still gets them.
